data.one_liner: An asynchronous audio capture library for real-time speech audio processing.
data.what_it_does: Captures raw audio data from the device microphone and delivers 16-bit mono PCM frames to registered listeners. It is designed specifically for real-time speech processing use cases on mobile devices.
use_when: You need real-time streaming of raw audio frames for speech processing or recognition.
You want a singleton voice processor with support for multiple frame listeners.
avoid_when: You want to record compressed audio files to disk (like MP3 or AAC).
You need complex media playback features.
strengths: Delivers raw audio frames (16-bit, mono PCM) suitable for real-time speech engines.
Supports multiple listeners on a single recording session.
weaknesses: Limited to raw PCM audio capture and specific configurations.
Requires manual platform permission configuration for microphone access.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding NSMicrophoneUsageDescription in Info.plist for iOS and RECORD_AUDIO permission in AndroidManifest.xml for Android.

alternatives.name: record
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a general-purpose audio recorder that can output to files or stream amplitude/data.
